text_block_list.text:
Today, I went out drinking with Tucker Brine!
He said he found a great izakaya with private rooms and brought me along, but...
choice_data_list: Ooh~! What a truly lovely shop!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's the least I can do to thank you for the other day,
and I wanted to share some delicious food with you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
A-All kinds of things happened, alright?!
Like the other day at the bookstore...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: You... didn't ask me a single thing.

Hearing her say that, I finally remembered.
Still, it wasn't something warranting thanks.
As I hesitated over what to say—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
It might not seem like a big deal to you,
but either way... my deepest thanks!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So with that said,
make sure you enjoy yourself todayyy!

And so, we relished the drinks and dishes
brought out one after another.
She seemed to hold her liquor surprisingly well...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Pffhhhaaaah!
Another draft beer here!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't mind sake, but
I'm the type to get messy drunk on it~!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer?
Can you hold your liquor? Huh? Well?
If you can't, how about some of this homemade lemonade—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh~~! *hic*...!
Man, I sure drank a lot...
choice_data_list: Shall we ask for some water?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry about this...!
You really are, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Deep down,
you've already realized it, haven't you...?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The me of the past was……
………………――

text_block_list.name: Student Tucker
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa......
Last place... again...

text_block_list.name: Tucker's Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Tucker, that's incredible~!
Another perfect score across all subjects!
You can get into any high school you want with grades like this!

text_block_list.name: Student Tucker
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I take both seriously...
What's the point if I'm only good at studying...?)

text_block_list.name: Student Tucker
text_block_list.text: What a boring Umamusume I am...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: (Yet... the thing that blew all that gloom away was racing itself――)

text_block_list.name: Student Tucker
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! Incredible, incredible!
Sooooo awesome...!!!

text_block_list.name: Student Tucker
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Everyone looks so dazzling.
I want to see more and more...!
This radiance...!

text_block_list.name: Student Tucker
text_block_list.text:
Right...
Is there any way I can help those girls...?
If it's just support, surely I can...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
(And with that, things finally "began."
Until then, I was always looking down at the ground...)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrrrrmmm............!
*hic*...!

The moment she said, "The old me..."
she suddenly fell silent.
Could she have been reminiscing about the past?

Everyone has a past. All kinds of pasts...
Even if she feels ashamed of hers,
to me, the girl she is now is—
choice_data_list: Well, no matter what happened in the past, who you are right now is...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Grrrroooooooowl!

—Stepping out of the taxi,
Tucker Brine snapped awake.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Where is this?
choice_data_list: Your place was this way, right, Tucker?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Did I... fall asleep...?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me!
It appears I... drank too much...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And what's more...!
Ah, to rant and rave like that...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. Truly, forgive the inconvenience...!
I have only a vague recollection of what I said, but, well...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The truth is!
Back then, I... ngh...!

Her mouth flapped open and closed frantically.
Honestly, I couldn't find the right words either.
Still, there was one thing I had to tell her.
choice_data_list: The way you are right now is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
choice_data_list: I respect you. Every single side of you that I've seen.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You'd... say that for me............?
You really are...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Thanks for today...
